description: Capability for the main window (desktop only)
comment: No fs and no dialog permissions: the webview never touches the
filesystem and never picks a file. pick_and_import_image opens the
dialog, reads the bytes and stores them entirely in Rust, which is not
subject to this ACL, so a chosen path never crosses IPC and cannot be
supplied by anything rendering in the webview.
